text:
junior-eng: Hey team—I'm starting on-call next week and want to confirm the shadow pairing schedule + runbook access. I tried opening the runbook link from the handbook but got a 403. Who should I ping for permissions?

mike-sre: Welcome! :tada: Ping me or @elaine for runbook perms. Which run you got assigned?

junior-eng: Assigned to Week B rotation (pager B). My onboarding email said to shadow someone for the first two incidents.

elaine: Got it. I can pair Tue/Wed mornings. I'll walk through triage flow, severity rubric, and the automatic escalation rules.

junior-eng: Awesome, thanks. For PagerDuty access I saw an invite but it didn't finish. Any self-serve steps?

mike-sre: The common flow: 1) Accept PD invite email, 2) add MFA, 3) join the "Redwood Oncall" PD schedule. If invite expired, DM me and I'll re-send. Quick checklist I use:```- Accept invite
- Set up 2FA
- Enable push notifications in PD app
- Join oncall slack channel + add your phone to contact info```

junior-eng: I accepted but the schedule doesn't show up. When I run `pd-schedule list` locally it errors with "schedule not found". Is that a CLI thing?

mike-sre: That's the PD CLI; the error means your API key isn't scoped. Try the web UI first. If missing there it's definitely a permissions issue. I'll re-issue the schedule invite now.

oncall-bot: @junior-eng has been added to the Week B shadow pairing list. Shadow pairing: @elaine (Tue 09:30-11:30), @mike-sre (Thu 14:00-16:00).

junior-eng: Thanks bot! One more: are there any simulated incidents I should complete before my first night? I want to practice runbook steps without causing noise.

elaine: Yes — run the incident dry-run playbook in staging. It's under Runbooks > "Incident Dry Run". It includes a scripted alert and a check-off list. If you want, we can run one Tue 10:00 during our shadow.

junior-eng: That would be perfect. Also, should I bring anything specific for the pairing (notes, laptop config)?

mike-sre: Bring your laptop, ensure SSH key in ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub is uploaded to the infra team, and have `kubectl` + `redwoodctl` installed. If you don't have them, run:```brew install kubectl``` and ```curl -sSL https://redwood.tools/install.sh | bash```

junior-eng: Got it. I actually don't have redwoodctl yet—I'll install now. If I hit perms 403 on the runbook again, I'll DM @mike-sre.

sara: FYI there will be an on-call orientation doc meetup Friday 11:00 for anyone who wants extra walkthroughs. Highly recommended. :thumbsup:

junior-eng: Thanks everyone — feel much less nervous. See you Tue morning for shadowing! :grinning_face_with_big_eyes:
